residue.message: The operator rejected the case-first language as too flowery and too similar to a staged science-video reveal.
The operator rejected an opening centered on software-engineering intimidation and requested a broader definitional frame across multiple contexts.
The operator directed Whisper to perform the full rewrite using a plain definition, plural contexts, one concrete organizational case, and the existing authority boundaries.
The v1 captions, picture score, teleprompter, and HTML remain unchanged until the complete v2 wording is reviewed.
